releaseNotes: 6D6X6 2.5.72.0: fixes the long first-frame delay on Windows 11 by priming the synchronous Media Foundation H.264 encoder when DXGI returns only one static frame. RTP queue recovery now keeps the newest encoded frame flowing while requesting a key frame instead of starving the Viewer. Five-second diagnostics now separate capture, H.264 and RTP send timing with avgRtp and maxRtp metrics. Windows 10 keeps the existing media path.
